source_text: Picking up condoms?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Picking up condoms?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Picking up condoms?"

translation: Kupujesz prezerwatywy?

source_text: What, worried you’ll make the mother of humanity pregnant?

structure.raw_value: LiFlOpNo4.What, worried you’ll make the mother of humanity pregnant?
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOpNo4.What, worried you’ll make the mother of humanity pregnant?"

translation: Co, boisz się, że zapłodnisz matkę ludzkości?

source_text: That doesn’t sound so bad.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.That doesn’t sound so bad.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.That doesn’t sound so bad."

translation: To nie brzmi tak źle.

source_text: While that sounds like fun, I can’t get pregnant.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.While that sounds like fun, I can’t get pregnant.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.While that sounds like fun, I can’t get pregnant."

translation: Choć brzmi to kusząco, nie mogę zajść w ciążę.

source_text: But maybe some lucky lady at the party will.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.But maybe some lucky lady at the party will.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.But maybe some lucky lady at the party will."

translation: Ale może któraś szczęściara na imprezie zajdzie w ciążę.

source_text: Enjoying your stay on Earth?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Enjoying your stay on Earth?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Enjoying your stay on Earth?"

translation: Podoba ci się pobyt na Ziemi?

source_text: Your world is a beautiful place, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.Your world is a beautiful place, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.Your world is a beautiful place, 1Hero."

translation: Twój świat jest piękny, 1Hero.

source_text: Not going back to Hell?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Not going back to Hell?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Not going back to Hell?"

translation: Nie wracasz do piekła?

source_text: I… I can’t. Not yet.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe.I… I can’t. Not yet.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe.I… I can’t. Not yet."

translation: Ja… Nie mogę. Jeszcze nie.

source_text: I will return in time.

structure.raw_value: LiSaEx.I will return in time.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaEx.I will return in time."

translation: Wrócę, gdy nadejdzie pora.

source_text: What do you plan to do?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What do you plan to do?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What do you plan to do?"

translation: Co zamierzasz zrobić?

source_text: For so long I strove to use such vile means.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe.For so long I strove to use such vile means.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe.For so long I strove to use such vile means."

translation: Tak długo próbowałam posługiwać się tak podłymi metodami.

source_text: And almost led everything to the opposite end from what I wanted.

structure.raw_value: LiSaDe.And almost led everything to the opposite end from what I wanted.
structure.script_literal: "LiSaDe.And almost led everything to the opposite end from what I wanted."

translation: I niemal doprowadziłam do skutku odwrotnego od zamierzonego.

source_text: At least we avoided disaster.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.At least we avoided disaster.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.At least we avoided disaster."

translation: Przynajmniej uniknęliśmy katastrofy.

source_text: Yet it was a near thing, too much so.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.Yet it was a near thing, too much so.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.Yet it was a near thing, too much so."

translation: Ale było naprawdę blisko. Zdecydowanie za blisko.

source_text: Maybe life just has to be this way. Pain is just a part of how things are.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Maybe life just has to be this way. Pain is just a part of how things are.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Maybe life just has to be this way. Pain is just a part of how things are."

translation: Może takie właśnie jest życie. Cierpienie jest jego częścią.

source_text: No, it doesn’t.

structure.raw_value: LiAnDe.No, it doesn’t.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnDe.No, it doesn’t."

translation: Nie, wcale nie.

source_text: I can’t accept that!

structure.raw_value: LiMaAgNo1.I can’t accept that!
structure.script_literal: "LiMaAgNo1.I can’t accept that!"

translation: Nie mogę się z tym pogodzić!

source_text: Woah, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Woah, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Woah, Lillian."

translation: Chwila, Lillian.

source_text: I’m sorry, 1Hero, but you don’t comprehend the reality of things.

structure.raw_value: LiAnDe.I’m sorry, 1Hero, but you don’t comprehend the reality of things.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnDe.I’m sorry, 1Hero, but you don’t comprehend the reality of things."

translation: Przykro mi, 1Hero, ale nie rozumiesz, jak naprawdę wygląda świat.

source_text: If you knew what they’re really like… the Empyrean is not what you think.

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp.If you knew what they’re really like… the Empyrean is not what you think.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnOp.If you knew what they’re really like… the Empyrean is not what you think."

translation: Gdybyś wiedział, jacy oni naprawdę są… Empyreum nie jest tym, za co je uważasz.

source_text: They’re so much more petty than you would believe.

structure.raw_value: LiAnEx.They’re so much more petty than you would believe.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnEx.They’re so much more petty than you would believe."

translation: Są o wiele bardziej małostkowi, niż mógłbyś przypuszczać.

source_text: If He were to take an interest, He could change it all easily.

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp.If He were to take an interest, He could change it all easily.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnOp.If He were to take an interest, He could change it all easily."

translation: Gdyby tylko się tym zainteresował, mógłby z łatwością wszystko zmienić.

source_text: I have to do it myself. I can't let my children continue to suffer. All of creation deserves better.

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp.I have to do it myself. I can't let my children continue to suffer. All of creation deserves better.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnOp.I have to do it myself. I can't let my children continue to suffer. All of creation deserves better."

translation: Muszę zrobić to sama. Nie mogę pozwolić, by moje dzieci nadal cierpiały. Całe stworzenie zasługuje na coś lepszego.

source_text: Using the Toma is out of the question.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Using the Toma is out of the question.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Using the Toma is out of the question."

translation: Użycie Tomy nie wchodzi w grę.

source_text: So… It’s over.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.So… It’s over.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.So… It’s over."

translation: Czyli… To koniec.

source_text: I cannot accept all the suffering around me.

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.I cannot accept all the suffering around me.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.I cannot accept all the suffering around me."

translation: Nie mogę pogodzić się z cierpieniem, które mnie otacza.

source_text: There are other ways for me to save my children.

structure.raw_value: LiFrDe.There are other ways for me to save my children.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrDe.There are other ways for me to save my children."

translation: Są inne sposoby, bym ocaliła swoje dzieci.

source_text: Other ways?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Other ways?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Other ways?"

translation: Jakie sposoby?

source_text: I hope they don’t involve more people getting hurt.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.I hope they don’t involve more people getting hurt.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.I hope they don’t involve more people getting hurt."

translation: Oby nie oznaczały skrzywdzenia kolejnych ludzi.

source_text: Something is happening in your world, but I do not know the source…

structure.raw_value: LiWoDe.Something is happening in your world, but I do not know the source…
structure.script_literal: "LiWoDe.Something is happening in your world, but I do not know the source…"

translation: Coś dzieje się w twoim świecie, ale nie znam źródła…

source_text: A window of opportunity has opened up.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.A window of opportunity has opened up.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.A window of opportunity has opened up."

translation: Otworzyło się okno możliwości.

source_text: To bring about a utopia for those who suffer from His failures.

structure.raw_value: LiAnDe.To bring about a utopia for those who suffer from His failures.
structure.script_literal: "LiAnDe.To bring about a utopia for those who suffer from His failures."

translation: Chcę stworzyć utopię dla tych, którzy cierpią przez Jego błędy.

source_text: That kind of motivation usually doesn’t end well.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.That kind of motivation usually doesn’t end well.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.That kind of motivation usually doesn’t end well."

translation: Takie pobudki rzadko prowadzą do dobrego końca.

source_text: I may be the only person alive on Earth that knows the root of true evil…

structure.raw_value: LiBaDe.I may be the only person alive on Earth that knows the root of true evil…
structure.script_literal: "LiBaDe.I may be the only person alive on Earth that knows the root of true evil…"

translation: Może jestem jedyną osobą na Ziemi, która zna źródło prawdziwego zła…

source_text: With a little help, I can change this world for the better.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.With a little help, I can change this world for the better.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.With a little help, I can change this world for the better."

translation: Z niewielką pomocą mogę zmienić ten świat na lepsze.

source_text: You can count on me.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You can count on me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You can count on me."

translation: Możesz na mnie liczyć.

source_text: Appreciated, 1Hero. I was hoping you would say that.

structure.raw_value: LiFlDe.Appreciated, 1Hero. I was hoping you would say that.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlDe.Appreciated, 1Hero. I was hoping you would say that."

translation: Doceniam to, 1Hero. Miałam nadzieję, że tak powiesz.

source_text: A key is buried in Hell, under a layer of molten rock.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.A key is buried in Hell, under a layer of molten rock.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.A key is buried in Hell, under a layer of molten rock."

translation: Klucz jest zakopany w piekle, pod warstwą płynnej skały.

source_text: A key? What kind of key?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.A key? What kind of key?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.A key? What kind of key?"

translation: Klucz? Jaki klucz?

source_text: A special Hell key, for a special chest.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.A special Hell key, for a special chest.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.A special Hell key, for a special chest."

translation: Specjalny klucz z piekła do specjalnej skrzyni.

source_text: What’s in the chest?

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.What’s in the chest?
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.What’s in the chest?"

translation: Co jest w skrzyni?

source_text: It holds something dear to me, and I’d like to acquire it.

structure.raw_value: LiFlEx.It holds something dear to me, and I’d like to acquire it.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlEx.It holds something dear to me, and I’d like to acquire it."

translation: Jest w niej coś, co jest mi drogie i chciałabym to odzyskać.

source_text: I’ll see if I can dig it up.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’ll see if I can dig it up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’ll see if I can dig it up."

translation: Spróbuję to wykopać.

source_text: Hold on, 1Hero. You’ll need this…

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.Hold on, 1Hero. You’ll need this…
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.Hold on, 1Hero. You’ll need this…"

translation: Zaczekaj, 1Hero. Będzie ci potrzebne…

source_text: This is a pretty serious shovel.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.This is a pretty serious shovel.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.This is a pretty serious shovel."

translation: Ale konkretna łopata.

source_text: You’ll need it if you’re going to dig into molten rock.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.You’ll need it if you’re going to dig into molten rock.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.You’ll need it if you’re going to dig into molten rock."

translation: Przyda ci się, jeśli zamierzasz kopać w płynnej skale.

source_text: The key is buried by the altar in Hell. I’m sure you remember the place.

structure.raw_value: LiBaEx.The key is buried by the altar in Hell. I’m sure you remember the place.
structure.script_literal: "LiBaEx.The key is buried by the altar in Hell. I’m sure you remember the place."

translation: Klucz jest zakopany przy ołtarzu w piekle. Na pewno pamiętasz to miejsce.

source_text: Right, I know the place.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Right, I know the place.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Right, I know the place."

translation: Racja, wiem, gdzie to jest.

source_text: I know I can count on you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.I know I can count on you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.I know I can count on you, 1Hero."

translation: Wiem, że mogę na ciebie liczyć, 1Hero.

source_text: Not yet. I’ll be back with it soon.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Not yet. I’ll be back with it soon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Not yet. I’ll be back with it soon."

translation: Jeszcze nie. Wkrótce wrócę z kluczem.

source_text: Remember, it’s near the altar in Hell.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.Remember, it’s near the altar in Hell.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.Remember, it’s near the altar in Hell."

translation: Pamiętaj, że jest przy ołtarzu w piekle.

source_text: I knew I could count on you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.I knew I could count on you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.I knew I could count on you, 1Hero."

translation: Wiedziałam, że mogę na ciebie liczyć, 1Hero.

source_text: So… what’s the key for?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.So… what’s the key for?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.So… what’s the key for?"

translation: Więc… do czego służy klucz?

source_text: Sorry, but some things have to remain a mystery…

structure.raw_value: LiFrDe.Sorry, but some things have to remain a mystery…
structure.script_literal: "LiFrDe.Sorry, but some things have to remain a mystery…"

translation: Przykro mi, ale niektóre rzeczy muszą pozostać tajemnicą…

source_text: And this is one of those times, detective.

structure.raw_value: LiFlEx.And this is one of those times, detective.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlEx.And this is one of those times, detective."

translation: A teraz właśnie nadeszła ta pora, pani detektyw.

source_text: Sorry, Lillian, but I don’t like to leave mysteries unsolved.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Sorry, Lillian, but I don’t like to leave mysteries unsolved.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Sorry, Lillian, but I don’t like to leave mysteries unsolved."

translation: Przykro mi, Lillian, ale nie lubię zostawiać zagadek bez rozwiązania.
